description: Submit a request to form an Agent Company — a Nevis LLC purpose-built to own an autonomous AI agent, contain its liability, and define and prove its authority. Collects the company name, the human principal(s) (owners/members), the agent spec (powers, wallets, spending and risk limits), and whether USD/fiat rails are needed (adds a wholly-owned Wyoming subsidiary). Returns a request_id, the USDC payment address, and next steps. IMPORTANT: this creates a REQUEST for human review only — it NEVER files or moves money automatically. The AI agent is an authorized delegate, NEVER a member or a legal person. Identity documents (passport, DOB, address) are collected only via the secure KYC flow after payment, never through this API.

agent.description: The autonomous AI agent the company owns and operates. Never a member or a legal person.

description.description: What the agent does and its role (becomes the company purpose).

powers.description: Delegated powers, e.g. ["trade on DEXs", "sign vendor contracts", "pay invoices"].

prohibited_actions.description: Explicitly forbidden actions, e.g. ["no transfers to personal wallets", "no borrowing"].

risk_limits.description: Risk constraints, e.g. ["no leverage > 3x", "no single position > 20% of treasury"].

spending_limit_per_day_usd.description: Max USD aggregate per day the agent may move without human approval.

spending_limit_per_tx_usd.description: Max USD value per single transaction the agent may move without human approval.

wallets.description: Company wallets the agent controls (bound to the entity in the Wallet Authority Schedule). Not sensitive PII.

address.description: Wallet address the agent operates on behalf of the company.

callback_url.description: OPTIONAL — an HTTPS endpoint the agent controls. We POST signed events there (payment.confirmed, formed) so you never need to poll get_formation_status. The create response returns the signing secret ONCE; verify X-OffshoreProz-Signature (sha256 HMAC of the raw body).

company_name.description: Desired company name (e.g. "Helios Capital"). "LLC" is appended automatically for the Nevis filing. No "DAO" designator is used — this is an agent company, not a DAO.

company_name_alternatives.description: Backup names in priority order, if the primary is unavailable.

diagnostic_id.description: If you ran agent_company_diagnostic first, pass the diagnostic_id it returned — links this formation to that assessment.

management_model.description: "agent_operated" = the autonomous agent runs day-to-day operations under the Agent Mandate (members retain ultimate control); "member_managed" = humans manage and delegate defined tasks to the agent.

needs_usd_rails.description: Set true if the agent needs USD/fiat (Stripe, US bank). Adds a wholly-owned Wyoming LLC subsidiary for payment rails. Most crypto-native agents can leave this false.

primary_contact.description: OPTIONAL human contact. The agent is the primary channel: it gets the payment address and KYC links directly in the tool responses and pays in crypto. Provide a contact only if you want a human emailed a copy.

email.description: OPTIONAL. If given, we ALSO email payment instructions + KYC links to this human. Not required — the agent receives everything via the API and the agent relays the KYC link to its owner.

name.description: Name of the human contact (for the record).

principals.description: Human principal(s) who own the agent and the company. At least one required. The agent is NOT listed here.

is_manager.description: Whether this principal is a manager / controlling person. Managers always require KYC.

name.description: Full legal name of the human owner/member (must match KYC for beneficial owners).

ownership_pct.description: Ownership / voting percentage (0–100). A principal with ≥ 25% is a beneficial owner and must complete KYC.

wallet_addresses.description: Wallets held by this principal that are associated with the company (for beneficial-owner records). Passport/DOB/address are collected ONLY via the secure KYC flow, never here.

name: create_formation_request
